newsitem.title: UK: Financial Times Info opens Manila office.
newsitem.headline: Financial Times Info opens Manila office.

text.p: Financial Times Information, owned by media and leisure group Pearson Plc, said on Monday it had opened a data processing facility in Manila to collect and analyse reports and accounts of Asian and Pacific companies.

The office, to be staffed by 80 analysts, will enable Financial Times Information to update financial, statistical and descriptive information on all listed Asian and Pacific companies within 48 hours of the data being available.
Financial Times Information, with the Financial Times Newspaper, is part of Pearson's information division.
